description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing purchase lists within a project. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting purchase lists, as well as handling related actions like removing ingredients from purchase lists. The controller interacts with project data, handles HTTP requests, and generates URLs for various actions.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::PurchaseList
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing purchase lists within a project.

methods.name: submenu
methods.description: Sets up submenu items for navigation related to purchase lists, unassigned items, and shop sections.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of purchase lists, including calculating default and minimum dates, and generating URLs for editing, updating, and deleting lists.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a specific purchase list by ID and prepares it for further actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a specific purchase list, including sections and units, and computes next higher and lower values for items.

methods.name: remove_ingredient
methods.description: Removes an ingredient from a purchase list and redirects back to the edit page.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new purchase list with a specified date.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the name of a purchase list, ensuring no duplicates and handling validation.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the index action of the purchase list controller.
